turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
How did that feel for you?
For the first time I think that I might survive this.
How did that feel for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I keep coming back to it.
What happened next?
I opened a betting site and looked at odds for ten minutes before closing it.
Take your time.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. It is not easy to talk about.
How did that feel for you?
Gareth was supportive and offered to pay for me to see a counsellor through the firm.
How did that feel for you?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. It is not easy to talk about.
And how was that for you?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
And how was that for you?
I go to the Thursday Gamblers Anonymous meetings every week, and Frank is now my sponsor.
And how was that for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
